== Walkthrough == Siladdarae N`Riese wants help with finding her [missing scrolls] so she can return home. She wants any of the following spell scrolls: * [[Color Slant]] * [[Cripple]] * [[Dementia]] * [[Theft of Thought]] The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls. == Dialogue == You say, 'Hail, Siladdarae N`Riese' Siladdarae N`Riese says 'Hello, _____. This place is quite a formidable outpost, but it lacks the comforts of home. Once I have finished collecting some of my [missing scrolls], I'll be able to leave this place and all its hidden dangers.' You say, 'What missing scrolls?' Siladdarae N`Riese says 'Travelers have been bringing back numerous scrolls from the depths of darkness in the Outlands. They contain arcane knowledge specific to our classes. Only four are left that I seek. Keep a wary out for Theft of Thoughts, Color Slant, Cripple, and Dementia. Return any one of these to me and your reward shall be a scroll that can be found nowhere else.' Upon hand-in: Siladdarae N`Riese says 'Here is the scroll that I promised. We have both gained much knowledge today. I hope to do business with you again soon. Farewell!' [[Category: Quests]] [[Category:The Overthere]] [[Category:Enchanter Quests]]
